name: bigquery-migration-data-loader
description: >- Provisions BigQuery datasets, ingests staged Parquet files directly into native BigQuery tables by using bq load, and deploys already-translated views from local or Cloud Storage BigQuery Migration Service (BQMS) translation outputs. Use when provisioning target BigQuery datasets for warehouse migrations, batch loading staged Parquet files into native BigQuery tables by using bq load, auditing loaded table row counts, or deploying already-translated BigQuery views into a target dataset.
